Careers

Armstrong is proud of the rich tapestry of ethnicity, origin and gender that makes us stronger every day. We value diversity and build teams with a variety of skills, competencies and backgrounds.

A platinum recipient of the Best Managed Companies award since 2007, Armstrong is also a purpose-driven organization. We are leading a global transformation in energy consumption, using energy-saving solutions to reduce Scope 1 and Scope 2 production of greenhouse gases. If you are driven by the same ideals, you can help us advance that change initiative.

Submit your application below.
